videos.title: A 2028 reckoning, data centers as a luxury belief, and the liberal arts comeback | Market Hang
videos.description:
Nancy Tengler hosts a panel that starts on big tech earnings and ends on what your children should study. Darius Dale, Founder and CEO of 42 Macro, says this market cycle will not survive contact with the 2028 general election, and explains why he thinks labor versus capital is at an extreme last seen before the New Deal. Mark Newton, Managing Director and Global Head of Technical Strategy at Fundstrat Global Advisors, is overweight healthcare and arrives at the same year by a different route.

Market Hang is live weekdays 12:30-1:30pm ET on Yahoo Finance.
